passage: Report: Community Help Day Success On Saturday, 15th October, our school organised a Community Help Day to support local families. The event began at 8 am with a hearty breakfast for all volunteers. We were given written guidelines to understand our tasks. Teams collected broken appliances, such as cookers, from the neighbourhood. These were repaired by skilled volunteers and donated to unemployed residents. Another group provided information on job opportunities, helping people collect useful resources. A marine biologist gave a talk about dolphin protection, educating everyone on environmental issues. The event was held at the community centre near the train station, attracting over 200 participants. Thanks to everyone's efforts, we raised funds and provided essential support to many families. The event was a great success, with volunteers working together smoothly. Many unemployed people received much-needed appliances, and the job information stall helped several individuals find new opportunities. The talk about dolphins also raised awareness about marine conservation in our community. Overall, it demonstrated how our community can unite to make a positive impact.
